confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on crowd-sourced Antigua averages (MyLifeElsewhere) and Guatemala-level Numbeo-based figures, which are rough and vary by source; the mid-range meal anchor leans on a Guatemala City-based figure. No search found cocktail or wine prices, so both are estimated from the beer anchor (roughly 2.5x and 2.3x beer). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Antigua's market and were not checked against live listings. FX: the RBA F11 table could not be opened or verified. The 0.6976 USD per AUD figure (3 November 2026) comes from a secondary rates site, and the rba.gov.au page appeared only as a search result with a stale March 2026 rate. Verify the as_of_date and source_rate against the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Guatemala-level and Antigua-specific crowd-sourced restaurant and café averages, with cocktail and wine set as multiples of the beer anchor. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a mid-sized colonial tourist town in Guatemala, based on model knowledge and not on any search.
